name: title-castle-v1
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production art for the Korean elementary-school fantasy tower-defense game 'Decimal Castle'. Original cheerful dark-dungeon fantasy, chunky hand-painted 2D game illustration, detailed angular gray stone, restrained gold/brass ornament, glowing amber fire and violet magic, warm hopeful mood, readable silhouettes, no realistic gore or horror. No typography, letters, numerals, UI, logos or watermark. Wide cinematic landscape composition, preferably 16:9. Create a spectacular game title-screen background, not a sprite sheet. Use the castle/flame in the reference only for visual style. A majestic small bastioned gray-stone fortress with one tall amber protective flame on its roof stands on the RIGHT HALF of an immense mysterious underground chamber. Amber reflections across a winding stone path, quiet stone towers in the foreground, hazy tall ruined arches and a faint violet portal in the far distance. Deep navy charcoal shadows and golden floating embers. Leave the LEFT 42 percent dark and visually quiet for a large title and four menu buttons to be added in code. Strong foreground/midground/background separation for cinematic parallax. Fortress appears slightly above the middle vertically. Polished premium game key art, beautiful lighting, fantastical and suitable for age ten.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation sprite atlas for the FINAL BOSS of a friendly fantasy dungeon tower defense.
